extracted.name: Pesto pasta spread
extracted.description: Serve up this simple spread for the kids to enjoy, including pesto pasta with mini mozzarella balls, tomatoes and garlic bread
ingredient_lines: 350g pasta any shape you like 100g fresh pesto (vegetarian if needed)
small bunch of basil leaves picked
½ lemon zested, plus a little juice
thin-stemmed broccoli spears or green beans
instruction_lines: Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Drain and return to the pan with a splash of the water.
Add the pesto, crème fraiche, basil and lemon zest, plus a squeeze of juice. Season and mix well. Serve the pasta at the table with the accompaniments for everyone to add themselves.
